main_text.p: quæstio, quod prima fronte duellantes existument, si non inter fortes saltem temerarios & audaces se referendos, adeoque ab omni prorsus metu se-junctos esse. Verùm tamen si quis rem recta lance mecum velit trutinare, non inficias ive-rit, permultos duellatores, si non plerosque, magis esse meticulosos, quam audaces. Atque hoc ipsum inter alia argu-menta, suadent arma, quibus utplurimum duellatores inter se congrediuntur. Raro enim eosdem sclopis, aut aliquo in-strumento læthali cujus ictus illatio est inevitabilis, in cam-pum prodire cernes. Verùm gladiis, & quidem oblongis, quibus facile ictum avertimus, & minimâ manubrii motita-tione periculum evitamus. Idque ex illo vulgato: prolixus gladius animi exilis indicium. page.notes: The running head is spaced in the print ("P. V O E T"); read as P. VOET, with the last letters doubtful. The catchword "ex-" is the start of the next page's first word. Long s is written as s throughout. Printed spellings "existument" and "ive-rit" are kept as printed. Some small specks and marks in the left margin are not printed text and are omitted.
